text: {"question": "What underlying conditions did the 14-year-old boy have who experienced recurrent early-morning episodes of barking cough and inspiratory stridor?", "answer": "The 14-year-old boy suffered from perennial allergic rhinitis and cough-predominant asthma.", "evidence": "We reported a 14-year-old boy with perennial allergic rhinitis and cough-predominant asthma who experienced 10 early-morning episodes of barking cough and inspiratory stridor between 2020 and 2024."}
